'''Chris Weigert''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2001 Mastic tournament]] on 4 August 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|profit]], according to Wayne Cullen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2778">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-04-mastic-ny-8-4-01d2778/ mastic-ny-8-4-01], DeckTech (Wayne "Rebel Scum" Cullen, 4 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-04-mastic-ny-8-4-01d2778/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
